hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *"auth switch"*|*"auth login"*|*"auth status"*) exit 0;; esac; case " $cmd" in *" gh "*|*" gh") acct=$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]+user:' "${GH_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.config/gh}/hosts.yml" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}'); [ "$acct" = "Palissp" ] || { echo "BLOCKED: the active gh account is '${acct:-unknown}'; this repo is personal (Palissp). Run: gh auth switch --user Palissp" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0
